description: An admitted Git Town runtime. EXECUTABLE_ABSENT is a state, not a failure and not a pass: nothing ran, so nothing about Git Town's behaviour follows. Absence unlocks no mode, and a human review cannot promote it.

admission.description: Version, checksum, provenance and licence together. Anything less names a tool, and a tool is not a thing that ran.

modes_available.description: A closed set of named modes. A caller that can supply argv can supply --continue, and --continue resolves a semantic conflict on the agent's own judgement.

profile.description: Closed and path-neutral. A config naming someone's home directory works exactly once, and the second machine's failure looks like a Git Town problem.

title: Git Town runtime admission
